title: A WITNESS FOR THE NEXT GENERATION

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "No! We did it for fear that some day your descendants might say to ours, 'What do you have to do with the Lord, the God of Israel? The Lord has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you — you Reubenites and Gadites! You have no share in the Lord.' So your descendants might cause ours to stop fearing the Lord. That is why we said, 'Let us get ready and build an altar — but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.'" — Josh 22:24-26 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
At last the real reason is revealed, and it is deeply moving. The eastern tribes were not thinking of themselves at all — they were thinking of their grandchildren. They feared that one day the Jordan River might become a wall, and the western tribes' descendants might say to theirs, "You have no share in the Lord." So they built a memorial to declare, for generations to come, that they too belonged to God.

What foresight of faith. They were worried not about land or wealth but about whether their children's children would still be counted among God's people. Their deepest concern was the spiritual future of the next generation.

This is a challenge to us. Are we as concerned for the faith of those who come after us? It is easy to focus on our own walk and forget that we are called to hand faith on. God commanded Israel to teach His ways diligently to their children (Deut 6:6-7), and the New Testament rejoices when faith passes from grandmother to mother to child (2 Tim 1:5).

Think about what you are building that will speak to the next generation. Will your children and grandchildren know that they, too, have a share in the Lord? Live and testify in a way that leaves them in no doubt.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. How concerned are you for the faith of the next generation?
2. What are you building or leaving that will point others to God?
3. How can you help children around you know they belong to the Lord?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, give me a heart for those who come after me. Help me to live and testify in a way that leads the next generation to know and fear You. Amen.
